content.short: Bitwave is a digital asset finance platform that manages crypto tax, accounting, and compliance.
content.description: Bitwave is a digital asset finance platform designed to manage the intersection of cryptocurrency tax, accounting, and compliance. By centering these areas, the platform seeks to enable organizations to carry out digital asset activities in a way that remains compliant with tax rules and regulatory expectations. In this way, Bitwave supports the financial operations around digital assets, helping teams maintain coherent financial records and governance as digital asset usage grows.
